category_edits.rationale: Blend each current GRU state with its causal, padding-masked recency pool: 85% current state and 15% pooled states with a five-interaction half-life. At inference this blends the last valid state with the corresponding pool. Applies to all four datasets; the generated predictor imports the updated model class directly.

response.change_summary: Change only recurrent-state readout to the requested 85/15 blend, preserving the GRU backbone, scoring, loss, optimizer, routing, and checkpoint format.
